origin.notes: Real freestanding Cortex-M4 ELF and native LLD MAP generated with LLVM 18. It links no runtime libraries and uses a literal linker-script MEMORY block.
origin.compilerVersion: Ubuntu Clang, LLVM, LLD, llvm-objdump, and llvm-nm 18.1.3-1ubuntu1
origin.artifactLicense: MIT; generated solely from the included source and linker script with no runtime libraries
origin.provenance: Generated locally from Ubuntu noble-updates LLVM 18.1.3-1ubuntu1 packages downloaded and extracted without system installation.
origin.generationCommand: clang --target=thumbv7em-none-eabi -mcpu=cortex-m4 -g -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -c -o firmware.o startup.S && ld.lld -flavor gnu -T linker.ld -Map=firmware.map -o firmware.elf firmware.o && llvm-objdump -h --show-lma firmware.elf > objdump-sections.txt && llvm-nm -C -S -n -l --defined-only firmware.elf > nm-symbols.txt
